screen.cozyconversation.title: Cozy Conversation
dialogue.cozy.farmer_tip: The crops are looking healthy this season.
dialogue.cozy.farmer_compliment: Thank you for lending a hand with the harvest!
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line00: Oh! Hello there… it's nice to see you.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line01: The weather feels gentle today, doesn't it?
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line02: I've been thinking about warm tea and soft blankets.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line03: Sometimes the village feels safest at dusk.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line04: Thank you for stopping by… that means a lot.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line05: Have you seen the flowers blooming near the river?
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line06: There's a gentle breeze carrying stories from afar.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line07: I enjoy watching the clouds drift lazily.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line08: Our village well is crystal clear today.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line09: The birds have been singing sweetly all morning.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line10: Do you like evenings as much as I do?
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line11: I've been tidying up my little cottage.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line12: The smell of fresh bread always makes me happy.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line13: Our neighbours are kind folk indeed.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line14: A cozy fire is all I need on a cold night.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line15: Simple moments make the heart feel full.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line16: I planted a few herbs today; hopefully they take root.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line17: A gentle rain brings life to our crops.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line18: Thank you for greeting me so warmly.
dialogue.cozy.tier0_line19: Every day holds a new little joy.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line00: It's wonderful to see a familiar face again.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line01: I appreciate how you listen to my stories.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line02: The sunset was stunning yesterday, wasn't it?
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line03: Our pets have been extra cuddly lately.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line04: I made a pot of stew if you'd like some later.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line05: Sometimes I hum old lullabies while I work.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line06: Do you ever feel nostalgic for childhood games?
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line07: I found a shiny pebble near the stream – it's yours.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line08: Let's reminisce about simpler times together.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line09: I love the way lantern light dances at night.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line10: We've shared quite a few laughs already.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line11: I saved you a seat by the fireplace.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line12: Rainy days are perfect for reading books.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line14: Sometimes my mind drifts to faraway places.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line15: I baked extra cookies; have as many as you'd like.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line16: The stars were sparkling brilliantly last night.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line17: Do you ever talk to the animals? I do.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line18: I've started keeping a journal of our conversations.
dialogue.cozy.tier1_line19: Little acts of kindness make big differences.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line00: I feel comfortable sharing secrets with you.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line01: There was a funny incident with the chickens today…
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line02: Would you like to join me for a stroll through the orchard?
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line03: I dream of exploring beyond the mountains someday.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line04: Sometimes I write poetry about the village.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line05: Your presence always lifts my spirits.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line06: I have a spare scarf if you ever need one.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line07: Could you help me decide which flowers to plant next season?
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line08: I've started painting, but I'm not very good yet.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line09: Do you think the villagers would enjoy a festival?
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line10: Thank you for always checking on me.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line11: We should create a secret handshake!
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line12: I sometimes worry about the monsters at night.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line13: Let's cook a new recipe together sometime.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line14: Your friendship means the world to me.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line15: Maybe we could plant a community garden.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line16: Have I told you about my favorite song?
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line17: I trust you more than anyone else here.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line18: Let's build a snowman when winter arrives.
dialogue.cozy.tier2_line19: I think we make a great team.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line00: I'm so grateful for our growing friendship.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line01: Remember when we fixed the roof together? That was fun.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line02: I wrote a song inspired by your kindness.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line03: I feel safe when you're around.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line04: We should host a picnic for the whole village.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line05: Let's share stories by the campfire tonight.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line06: You always know how to cheer me up.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line07: I stitched a small token of appreciation for you.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line09: I had the strangest dream last night…
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line10: Sometimes I think we could travel the world together.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line11: I'd love to craft something special with you.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line13: I'm planning a surprise; will you help me?
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line14: I have a secret spot by the river; let's go sometime.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line15: You deserve all the nice things in the world.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line16: I'm proud of everything we've accomplished together.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line17: I treasure every moment we spend together.
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line18: Shall we build something amazing today?
dialogue.cozy.tier3_line19: I'm here for you whenever you need me.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line00: Our bond is unbreakable; you're my dearest friend.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line01: I can't imagine life without you in our village.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line02: Let's go on an adventure beyond the horizon!
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line03: I crafted a gift especially for you.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line04: Together, we can face any challenge.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line05: You light up my world like a thousand lanterns.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line06: Every day with you is a blessing.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line07: I baked your favourite cake to celebrate our friendship.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line08: Your support has made me stronger than ever.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line09: Let's plant a tree together to mark our bond.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line10: You inspire me to be the best version of myself.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line11: I want you to meet my family; they will love you.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line12: When I'm with you, I feel like anything is possible.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line13: You are like family to me.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line14: Let's build our dream house together.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line15: I wrote a heartfelt letter for you.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line17: No matter what happens, I'll always be by your side.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line18: Let's celebrate our milestones with a feast.
dialogue.cozy.tier4_line19: You have a special place in my heart.
